results.description:
Beat friends. Outdo yourself.

Outdo turns your Apple Watch rings — or just your step count — into a competition with the people who will actually push you. Scored fairly, with no ceiling on effort.

NO CAPS ON EFFORT
Most fitness competitions stop counting the moment you hit 100%. Outdo doesn't.
• Double your Move goal, earn double the points
• Move and Exercise are uncapped — your hardest days are worth what they cost you
• Stand caps out, because standing up isn't effort

EVERYONE SEES EVERYTHING
No ranks, no vague summaries. Every member of a competition sees:
• Exact ring values — kcal, minutes, hours
• The goal each person was measured against
• Points, daily totals and best days
• How many rounds everyone has played

NOBODY CAN GAME THE GOAL
Whoever creates a competition sets one target for everyone in it. You are never scored against a goal you picked for yourself, so setting an easy target to win is structurally impossible. The same workout is worth more in a casual group than a serious one — and that is the point.

NUDGE A FRIEND
When a rival's numbers look stale, tap Nudge. They get a notification telling them exactly where they stand and by how much, and their app pulls fresh data the moment they open it.

COMPETITIONS THAT KEEP GOING
• Create a group, share a code, invite anyone
• Repeating rounds that run until you end them
• Every finished round kept — podium results and season standings
• No forced weekly resets, no history thrown away

NO WATCH? COMPETE ON STEPS
Every competition picks what it scores, so nobody is left watching from the sidelines.
• Steps competitions are counted by the iPhone in your pocket
• One shared daily target, and every step is a point
• Every name shows whether a Watch or an iPhone counted it, so the numbers are read honestly
• Free, not a paid extra

WHAT YOU NEED
An iPhone. Steps competitions need nothing else. Ring competitions score Move, Exercise and Stand from Apple Health, and an Apple Watch is what records all three — without one your iPhone still measures Move, so you can follow a ring competition and compete properly in a steps one.

PRIVACY
Outdo reads four things from Apple Health — your three rings, the goals behind them, and your step count — and writes nothing back to it. Your health data is never sold, never used to target advertising at you, and never shared outside the competitions you choose to join.

Every push-up app shows you the scoreboard. This one hides it.

PushUp Push is a head-to-head push-up race with one twist: you can't see how far ahead your rival is. The whole game lives in your head — are they crushing you, or bluffing? The only way to know is to make a move.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a number — 100 for a warm-up, 10,000 for legend status, or set your own.
• Send a friend the invite. The second they join, the race is on.
• Log your sets and climb toward the finish line. First one there wins.

FREE PUSH-UP CHALLENGES
Start a one-on-one or group push-up challenge for free, invite your friends, and race to the finish. Your rival's count stays hidden along the way, keeping every challenge competitive until the end.

POWER PLAYS CHANGE EVERYTHING
It's not just reps. It's a mind game.
• Peek — see their count for 24 hours (but they'll know you looked).
• Stealth Peek — see it silently. They'll never know.
• Spyglass & Recon Drone — track their pace and finish time.
• Poker Face, Smoke Screen, Blackout — go dark so they can't read you.
• Taunt Bomb & Decoy — get in their head and make them panic.

WILDCARD CHALLENGES
Fire a Wildcard Power Play to add 25 burpees, sit-ups, or air squats to everyone’s race — then track who completes it.

PROVE IT — OR DON'T
Add an optional photo or quick clip to any set so your rival sees you actually did it. They can view it for 24 hours, then it's gone for good. We never keep it.

SOLO OR SQUAD
Go one-on-one, or start a group race where nobody sees the standings until they finish their own.

Pick a rival. Pick a number. Find out who blinks first.

Also, my mom missed our old step challenges after the app we used removed them; they were fun, and we all walked more. Finally, motivation for me is an issue, so I wanted some sort of progress incentives in an RPG like format.

This App:

- Syncs with Apple Health for steps and metrics.

- Log every set, track steps, build custom plans, share workouts, invite friends and create custom challenges (for steps and workouts) for them.

- Set your step goal, earn badges and passport stamps, and create a virtual walking journey to real destinations that turns your miles into a trip toward landmarks.

- Workout plans can be manually built, shared with you, or built by AI (using your AI-Key so that I don't have to charge you extra $ for it).

- Expansive exercise library with over 350 exercises, including 30+ Yoga Poses. All have short descriptions and public video links to watch how to do them. Catalog searchable by name, muscle, and equipment. Build your multi-day exercise program with custom exercises, rests, sets and reps counts, leverage heart-rate zone targets, or time based as applicable.

- Create your workout plan in the App or on a Google Spreadsheet (your account). Edit it there, and import your changes back.

- Invite your friends to compete with them on workouts. Challenges support eight metrics: workouts, tonnage, sets and points, plus steps, distance and running time from your watch. Everyone is scored against their own daily goal, so a beginner and a marathoner race honestly. Form groups in one tap, cheer somebody mid-set, and climb eight weekly league divisions.

- Race in real life by building a course of up to twelve stops anywhere. Races are private and invite-only: people you ask, or people who used your link and whom you approved. The board shows each racer's last checked-in stop and when they reached it.

- RPG-style game underneath with points, levels, stats, achievement ladders, and a trophy case for a little extra motivation if you need it.

- Apple Watch support to run the workout session: log sets, see live heart-rate zones, pause, resume and mark a segment. It can run a whole workout on its own with no phone nearby.

- Coaching: A real coach can build and share an exercise plan with you. Adopt their program, train it, and share back how it went, one toggle per person, and off until you turn it on. Your coach can then see your shared progress and provide feedback.

- Muscle map colored by what you trained this week, fatigue tracking that suggests when to ease off, a readiness score that never blocks you, and progress charts going back as far as you do.

- AI: Bring your own or don't use it at all. The optional AI coach runs on a free Google Gemini key you fetch yourself and paste into Settings. We do not sell you AI and we never charge for tokens: the key stays on your device. Everything else here works with no key at all.

- Private by Default: Your training history, health data, and home location stay on your phone. Your home is a coordinate, never an address, and it never leaves the device.
